thread:
Aria (AE): Hey team - VertexAI Labs ready to sign the POC orderform but procurement returned MSA+DPA redlines. They insist on customer-managed AWS KMS for POC outputs and monthly committed billing. Need legal + sec + finance guidance before I reply. @Felix @Samir @Jo
Felix (Legal): Drop the redline bundle here. Short take: we don't permit CMKs on Hosted. We'll propose Dedicated/Private or a Security Exception. Also scanning for any overbroad indemnity or transfer clauses.
Aria (AE): Uploaded: vertex_msa_redlines.pdf and vertex_procurement_notes.pdf. They want DocuSign order: PO -> Vertex Legal -> Redwood Sales Ops -> Redwood Legal. No exec sig from them.
Samir (Security): CMKs on Hosted = hard no. Multi-tenant key handling is unsafe. We can support customer CMKs only on Dedicated or Private with strict controls: dedicated tenancy, key policy lock, audit-forwarding, and a revoke runbook.
Jo (Finance): Pricing note: at $20k/mo commit typical discount cap is 5% and net30. They asked net60 + 10% — that'll need RevOps/CRO signoff. Net45 + 7% might be doable if Security approves Dedicated.
MayaOps (Sales Ops): For DocuSign I need the final orderform PDF + signer emails. If Legal wants a provisional watermark, I can add it. Procurement requested no watermark but Legal prefers it. Which wins?
Felix (Legal): We must include a provisional watermark until Security Exception is complete. I'll prepare a redline reply that rejects CMKs on Hosted and offers: (A) Hosted w/ Redwood-managed keys; or (B) Dedicated w/ CMKs contingent on Security Exception and KMS Addendum.
Aria (AE): Vertex is concerned about lead time. They want to start within 72h. Can Dedicated be provisioned that fast?
Samir (Security): Typical Dedicated provisioning is 48-96h if capacity exists. We'll need onboarding steps completed before enabling CMKs. If they accept Hosted for initial tests and then cutover to Dedicated for CMKs, that's fastest.
Jo (Finance): If they accept Dedicated and $20k/mo commit, I can approve net45 + 7% pending Security sign-off. Net60 + 10% will require CRO approval.
MayaOps (Sales Ops): I'll draft the DocuSign envelope with signer order as requested and add a cover note saying "Provisional acceptance pending Security Exception". Need signer emails to proceed.
Felix (Legal): Also: don't accept unilateral audit or unlimited liability tied to key management. I'll annotate the vendor redlines and post comments by EOD.
Aria (AE): I'll present two options to procurement now: 1) Hosted w/ Redwood keys (fastest), standard terms; 2) Dedicated w/ CMKs, net45/7% and 48-72h provisioning.
notify-bot: capacity-check.csv uploaded -> https://files.redwood.com/capacity-check.csv :white_check_mark:
Samir (Security): If they pick Dedicated and want 99.95 SLA, expect ~20% uplift for reserved capacity and monitoring. Call that out in reply.
Jo (Finance): Confirming: net45 + 7% green if Security ok. Otherwise escalate.
MayaOps (Sales Ops): Once Aria posts which option they prefer, I'll assemble envelope and queue for signature. Will add Legal watermark per Felix.
Aria (AE): Thanks all. I'll send the two-option reply and collect signer emails. Will update here when I hear back from procurement. :thumbsup:
Felix (Legal): Posting redline comments in thread shortly. If procurement pushes CMKs for Hosted, we'll need to escalate and likely decline.
